title: SSC Hour-1 Bundle — static reference (2019 version)
display_notice: Clinician reference only. A CareSense Critical risk tier is a model output, not a sepsis diagnosis or a decision to start this bundle. Qualified healthcare professionals assess eligibility and choose treatment using current guidance and local protocols.
reference_topics: Lactate testing, including repeat measurement when the initial value is elevated.
Assessment for initial crystalloid resuscitation when hypotension or markedly elevated lactate is present.
Assessment for vasopressor support when hypotension persists during or after resuscitation.
topic_notice: These are reference topics, not patient-specific instructions. Read the official 2019 bundle for its conditions and numerical details, and consult the current adult guidelines and local protocols.
eligibility_notice: No checklist item is automatically applicable, completed or overdue based on model risk.
display_rule: May be shown as the same static reference when model probability is strictly greater than 0.75. The risk threshold never establishes bundle eligibility.
